d: Deep crimson hair is styled in a high ponytail with choppy bangs, framing a youthful face with narrow, sharp lime-green eyes. The slender build is dressed in a white crop top under a tan tactical vest, paired with a striped navy and burgundy scarf, black high-waisted leggings with multiple buckled straps, and chunky black platform boots. A large tan hiking backpack is worn on the back, accompanied by dark goggles resting around the neck and a small brown leather pouch attached to the hip.
